assets.name: avatar-heads
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: recolorable character avatar sprite atlas for children's web game. EXACTLY THREE evenly sized square cells side by side in one wide 3:1 image. Each contains the SAME centered front-facing head-and-shoulders CHILD bust, same friendly pose, same head size, identical eye mouth body placement. Left short spiky hair, center curly hair, right shoulder-length hair. No accessories. Crisp blocky 16-bit pixel art, large charming eyes and smiling mouth. Flat solid PURE WHITE background, no shadows behind figures, no cell borders. Controlled replacement palette: ALL hair saturated blue midtones and dark BLUE shadows. ALL skin warm ORANGE shades. BOTH irises saturated GREEN. ALL shirt MAGENTA/PINK. Outline near-black. Only use these hues in their designated regions. All three busts exactly same scale in each square cell: hair top around 10 percent down, shirt bottom 92 percent down, eyes at 48 percent down. No text, no logos, no watermark. Wide 3:1 canvas.

assets.name: accessories
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original pixel-art avatar accessory sprite atlas. EXACTLY THREE evenly spaced square cells side-by-side in wide 3:1 canvas. Genuinely transparent RGBA background, preserve actual alpha with empty pixels all around and inside openings. Left: round GOLD eyeglasses front view with empty transparent lens openings. Center: VIOLET headphones front view with empty transparent face opening. Right: TEAL baseball cap front view. Accessories ONLY, no heads, no faces, no hair, no bodies, no text, no logos, no cell borders. Crisp 16-bit pixel art, hard square edges and simple bold chunky forms with dark outlines. Each accessory horizontally centered in its equal square cell and entirely contained inside that cell with padding. Suitable for layering over child avatars.
